messages:
maya: Heads-up — noticing a perf regression tied to our warmup/probing logic + client retries. Big chunk of traffic (esp streaming) is making short-lived requests that never hit the KV cache but still trigger warmup kernels.

maya: Repro: client does 2 fast retries on 429/timeout, second attempt has slightly different headers so server treats it as new key => no prefetched KV, warmup kicks in, extra latency. Observed at p95 on dedicated pools. :frowning_face:

oz: Can you paste an example request/headers? curious if it's the opt-in header canonicalization or something else.

maya: sure — simplified:

```
POST /v1/generate
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer xxxxx
Content-Type: application/json
X-RW-CLIENT-ID: client-123
X-RW-PREFETCH: 1   # sometimes missing due to SDK retry wrapper
```

maya: Sometimes the SDK wrapper strips custom headers on retry, sometimes it keeps them. When header is missing warmup is skipped on the client but server-side prefetch keying still treats it as cold.

ash: That's a nasty interaction. Two obvious levers: (1) make server prefetch keying more tolerant to header presence (treat missing X-RW-PREFETCH same as 0 but still allow KV lookup) or (2) make SDK preserve headers across retries. Prefer both.

oz: Agreed. Also we should consider adding a short lived dedupe window server-side: if identical caller+payload arrives within 250ms, route to existing warmup + reuse prefetched KV if available. That would avoid duplicate kernel warmups caused by retries.

perf-bot: profiling snapshot (sampled 1m):
- requests w/o KV hit: 18.9% (baseline 7.1%)
- additional kernel cold starts correlated with retry header-mismatch: +12%
- p95 latency delta on affected jobs: +220ms
Link: https://perf.redwood.ai/flame/1793002468

maya: Nice. The SDK change is small but rolling it takes time. Can we do a quick server-side mitigation first? even a heuristic would help before SDK patch.

ash: I'll PR an opt-in tolerant keying rule: if X-RW-PREFETCH missing, fallback to canonical prefix key generated from model+prompt fingerprint only (no header gating). Also add a 300ms dedupe cache of in-flight warmups keyed by (client-id + prompt-fingerprint). If another request hits while warmup in progress, wait on the warmup instead of launching another kernel.

oz: Sounds good. Two notes: (a) the dedupe should be limited to requests targeting the same shard (avoid cross-shard sync), and (b) we need metrics for dedupe hits/misses.

perf-bot: added metrics plan: `warmup_dedupe_requests_total`, `warmup_dedupe_hits_total`, `prefetch_key_missing_total`. I'll add dashboards.

maya: For streaming, also watch partial-response retries where client reconnects and sends Range-like header — that currently changes the canonicalization. Can we canonicalize by removing ephemeral streaming params from the cache key?

ash: yes — propose a filter list for headers that are ignored when computing cache key: `X-RW-STREAM-SN`, `X-RW-RETRY-COUNT`, `X-RW-TMP`. We'll make it configurable.

oz: One more edge: retries with modified system prompts (clients sometimes add telemetry fields into the prompt on retry). We should detect tiny metadata diffs and normalize before keying (strip telemetry lines). Might be heavier, but can be limited to small heuristics.

maya: OK owners? ash -> server PR (dedupe + header filter), oz -> SDK patch to preserve custom headers across retries + quick release note, maya -> monitor dashboards and run canary on dedicated pool. perf-bot: add dashboards.

perf-bot: created issue RW-INT-4123, assigned ash/oz/maya. Timeline: server mitigation this week, SDK patch next week, monitor canary for 72h.

ash: quick server snippet I'll include in PR description:

```
// dedupe window: 300ms
if (in_flight_warmups.contains(key) && now - in_flight_warmups[key].start < 300ms) {
  wait_on(in_flight_warmups[key].promise)
  use(prefetched_kv_if_present)
} else {
  launch_warmup()
}
```

oz: For SDK: ensure `fetch`/`axios` wrappers copy all `headers` object into retry attempts. Also add a test that simulates a failure on first attempt and asserts header presence on retry.

maya: Thanks. Let's keep chat here minimal during rollout; post any anomalies to #eng-sre. :thumbsup:

ash: will do. :white_check_mark:

perf-bot: ETA: dashboards live in 20m, will post link when ready.
